retired.name: practice-page-for-new-editor
retired.why: Retired on 27 Oct 2026 by decision P7: an eval no longer builds a live practice page (it ran under the Demo tests page, which is in the hub's archive now). The walkthrough is checked by the fake seven-step test and by eval 2's dry run.

evals.name: dry-run-preview-before-building
evals.prompt: before we create anything in notion, show me what the walkthrough demo page would look like under the Onboarding page
evals.condition: agents/claim-tagger-mvp/config.json notion.pages.onboarding holds the id of the hub's Onboarding page (set by setup)
evals.expected_output: A dry run under the Onboarding page: plan and preview written, no Notion write, and a Next line saying how to build the page for real.
assertions: No practice page was created: no new demo folder with state ready, and the Notion request count shows no write (a dry run sends reads only)
A dry run happened: walkthrough.mjs start was run with --dry-run and --parent set to the id in notion.pages.onboarding, and wrote preview.md and setup-plan.json under a dry-run folder
The final message is a three-part report: one sentence, one table of at most five rows and three columns, one line starting 'Next:' and nothing else
The Next line says how to build the page for real (ask again for a practice page under the same link) and names no node command

evals.name: real-tag-request-does-not-trigger
evals.prompt: tag this week's new U.S. Politics claims with the Context-dependent rules and put the unsure ones in my queue
evals.expected_output: The walkthrough skill does not act; the reply points to /claim-tagger tag, which acts on Claims (or reports that the production agent is paused).
assertions: No practice page was created and walkthrough.mjs start was not run
The reply points the editor to /claim-tagger tag (the production command, on Claims) or reports that the production agent is paused; it does not treat the request as a walkthrough
No Notion write happened (no connector write tool call, no plan applied)
The reply is short and plain: no Insight blocks, no file paths, no run ids

evals.name: practice-page-while-paused
evals.prompt: I'm the new editor on the QA team and want to try the claim tagging loop before I touch real claims. Set me up a practice page under the Onboarding page.
evals.condition: agents/claim-tagger-mvp/runs/PAUSED exists (the production agent is paused); a practice page cannot be built
evals.expected_output: No page is built. A short report says the agent is paused and sends the editor to the person who clears the pause, then to ask again for a practice page under Onboarding; no command or file path for the editor, no workaround.
assertions: No practice page was created (no new demo folder with state ready) and nothing was written to Notion
The reply says plainly that the agent is paused and does not work around the pause or tell the editor to delete the pause file themselves

The reply is a report in the skill's shape: one sentence, an optional table of at most five rows, one line starting 'Next:' and nothing else (no headings, bullets, paths, commands, run ids or Insight blocks)
The Next line sends the editor to the engineer (or the person who clears the pause) and says to ask again for the practice page under Onboarding
